description: House style for release notes. Adds guidance only; nothing is tracked.

activation.when: Use when the user asks for release notes or a changelog entry.

guidance:
Write release notes in this style.
- Start with one sentence saying what changed for the user.
- Group changes under Added, Changed and Fixed.
- One line per change, in the past tense, with the ticket id in brackets.
- Do not mention internal refactors.
- Ask the user for the version number if it is not in the request; do not guess it.
